answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the garden check. Bindings are kept in anchor, verified in spiral, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. A farm of 2210 identities would post 563 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
